title: Google's NotebookLM Just Got Insanely Powerful (Cinematic Videos)
description:
Google just dropped a new NotebookLM feature that turns your documents into full cinematic videos.
Upload your notes, research, or PDFs and NotebookLM creates animated videos with narration.
Tell it what you want and Gemini acts like a director. It picks the style, format, and animations.
Uses Veo 3 for visuals and Gemini 3 for the script so everything stays accurate to your sources.
Currently available for AI Ultra subscribers with more plans coming soon.

🔗 Try NotebookLM: https://notebooklm.google.com
channel_name: Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies
